scope: Twelve release-description candidates for four existing update languages, separate from AGY84 bed-window drafts.

messages.english: Check a public US forecast reference
Country evidence → United States → Washington forecast
messages.translation: Ubufakazi bezwe → United States → Isibikezelo saseWashington

messages.english: Request the public Washington demonstration forecast from the National Weather Service. Source times, Celsius values and unknowns stay visible; this does not change crop dates or approve local advice.
messages.translation: Cela isibikezelo sesibonelo somphakathi saseWashington ku-National Weather Service. Izikhathi zomthombo, amanani e-Celsius nokungaziwa kuhlala kubonakala; lokhu akushintshi izinsuku zezitshalo noma kugunyaze izeluleko zendawo.

messages.english: Check a public US forecast reference
messages.translation: Lekola mohlala oa bolepi ba leholimo ba US

messages.english: Country evidence → United States → Washington forecast
messages.translation: Bopaki ba naha → United States → Bolepi ba Washington

messages.english: Request the public Washington demonstration forecast from the National Weather Service. Source times, Celsius values and unknowns stay visible; this does not change crop dates or approve local advice.
messages.translation: Kopa bolepi ba mohlala oa sechaba oa Washington ho National Weather Service. Linako tsa mohloli, boleng ba Celsius le tse sa tsejoeng li lula li bonahala; sena ha se fetole matsatsi a lijalo kapa ho amohela likeletso tsa lehae.

messages.english: Check a public US forecast reference
messages.translation: Sedzani tsumbo ya tsumbamutsho ya US

messages.english: Country evidence → United States → Washington forecast
messages.translation: Vhuṱanzi ha shango → United States → Tsumbamutsho ya Washington

messages.english: Request the public Washington demonstration forecast from the National Weather Service. Source times, Celsius values and unknowns stay visible; this does not change crop dates or approve local advice.
messages.translation: Humbelani tsumbamutsho ya tsumbo ya nnyi na nnyi ya Washington kha National Weather Service. Zwifhinga zwa tshiko, mivhalo ya Celsius na zwi sa ḓivhei zwi dzula zwi tshi vhonala; hezwi a zwi shanduli maḓuvha a zwiliṅwa kana u tendela nyeletshedzo ya henefho.

messages.english: Check a public US forecast reference
messages.translation: Kambela nkombiso wa maxelo lama rindzeriweke ya US

messages.english: Country evidence → United States → Washington forecast
messages.translation: Vumbhoni bya tiko → United States → Maxelo lama rindzeriweke ya Washington

messages.english: Request the public Washington demonstration forecast from the National Weather Service. Source times, Celsius values and unknowns stay visible; this does not change crop dates or approve local advice.
messages.translation: Kombela nkombiso wa mani na mani wa maxelo lama rindzeriweke ya Washington eka National Weather Service. Minkarhi ya xihlovo, mimpimo ya Celsius ni leswi nga tivekiki swi tshamaka swi vonaka; leswi a swi cinci masiku ya swibyariwa kumbe ku pasisa switsundzuxo swa ndhawu.
